As we stand on the brink of launching our Koios Lite Node into the mainnet, our journey has been marked by significant milestones and rigorous preparation. Our achievements so far underscore our commitment to innovation, accessibility, and the democratization of blockchain technology. Here's a glimpse of what we've accomplished:
・Launch of Koios Lite Node on Preview Network: We've successfully deployed the Koios Lite Node on the Preview network, showcasing a fully operational system that's ready for broader exposure. This critical step ensures that our infrastructure is robust, scalable, and capable of meeting the demands of our growing community.
・Integration with gRest: Our Koios Lite system seamlessly integrates with gRest, ensuring that users have access to a comprehensive suite of blockchain data tools. This integration highlights our commitment to providing a user-friendly experience that bridges the gap between complex blockchain data and actionable insights.

This functionality ensures that our users have access to the most up-to-date information, enabling informed decision-making and efficient development.
・Comprehensive Documentation and Public Instances: We've developed extensive documentation and launched public instances of the Koios Lite Node. This effort is designed to lower the entry barrier for developers and users alike, providing clear guidelines and accessible tools for engaging with our platform.

Proof of Achievements for Milestone 3

The accomplishments of Milestone 3: Ecosystem Expansion and Integration are comprehensively documented in the official project report, available on the Koios GitHub repository. This report provides detailed evidence of the milestone’s successful completion, highlighting key outcomes such as:

 • Ecosystem Expansion: Integration of multiple new initiatives into the Koios ecosystem, extending its reach and utility.
 • Infrastructure Enhancements: Development and implementation of changes required to support seamless integration of new projects.
 • Performance Validation: Rigorous performance testing to ensure new integrations operated reliably within the existing system.
 • Strategic Collaborations: Coordination with partner projects to achieve smooth and effective integration, reinforcing the ecosystem’s collaborative foundation.

For detailed metrics, technical insights, and a comprehensive breakdown of achievements, you can refer to the full Milestone 3 Report on GitHub: Koios Evolution Report – Milestone 3.

This document serves as a transparent and verifiable record of progress, reflecting the Koios project’s commitment to growth and accountability within the decentralised technology space.
